ClassSymbol.description:
Represents programming constructs like variables, classes, interfaces etc.
that appear in a document. Document symbols can be hierarchical and they
have two ranges: one that encloses its definition and one that points to
its most interesting range, e.g. the range of an identifier.

children.description: Children of this symbol, e.g. properties of a class.

deprecated.description: Indicates if this symbol is deprecated.

detail.description: More detail for this symbol, e.g the signature of a function.

name.description:
The name of this symbol. Will be displayed in the user interface and therefore must not be
an empty string or a string only consisting of white spaces.
